import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Survival Rate by Class
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
survival_by_class = df.groupby('pclass')['survived'].mean()
colors = ['#e74c3c', '#3498db', '#2ecc71']
ax1.bar(survival_by_class.index, survival_by_class.values, color=colors, alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Survival Rate by Sex
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
survival_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['survived'].mean()
colors_sex = ['#e91e63', '#2196f3']
ax2.bar(survival_by_sex.index, survival_by_sex.values, color=colors_sex, alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Sex', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Survival Rate by Sex', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Age Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
df_age = df.dropna(subset=['age'])
ax3.hist(df_age[df_age['survived']==1]['age'], bins=15, alpha=0.6, label='Survived', color='#2ecc71', edgecolor='black')
ax3.hist(df_age[df_age['survived']==0]['age'], bins=15, alpha=0.6, label='Not Survived', color='#e74c3c', edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
ax3.legend()
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Fare Distribution (log scale)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
df_fare = df[df['fare'] > 0]
ax4.hist(df_fare[df_fare['survived']==1]['fare'], bins=20, alpha=0.6, label='Survived', color='#2ecc71', edgecolor='black')
ax4.hist(df_fare[df_fare['survived']==0]['fare'], bins=20, alpha=0.6, label='Not Survived', color='#e74c3c', edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Fare', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Survival', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
ax4.legend()
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Survival by Embarked Port
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
survival_by_port = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].mean().dropna()
colors_port = ['#9b59b6', '#f39c12', '#1abc9c']
ax5.bar(survival_by_port.index, survival_by_port.values, color=colors_port, alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Embarked Port', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Survival by Family Size
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
survival_by_family = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].mean()
ax6.plot(survival_by_family.index, survival_by_family.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#3498db')
ax6.set_xlabel('Family Size', fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 7. Heatmap of Survival by Class and Sex
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
pivot = df.pivot_table(values='survived', index='sex', columns='pclass', aggfunc='mean')
sns.heatmap(pivot, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='RdYlGn', center=0.5, 
            cbar_kws={'label': 'Survival Rate'}, ax=ax7, linewidths=1, linecolor='black')
ax7.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Sex', fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)

# 8. Overall Statistics
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax8.axis('off')
total_passengers = len(df)
survived = df['survived'].sum()
survival_rate = survived / total_passengers
stats_text = f"""
TITANIC DATASET SUMMARY

Total Passengers: {total_passengers}
Survived: {int(survived)} ({survival_rate:.1%})
Not Survived: {int(total_passengers - survived)} ({1-survival_rate:.1%})

Average Age: {df['age'].mean():.1f}
Average Fare: ${df['fare'].mean():.2f}

Male Passengers: {(df['sex']=='male').sum()}
Female Passengers: {(df['sex']=='female').sum()}
"""
ax8.text(0.1, 0.5, stats_text, fontsize=11, verticalalignment='center', 
         fontfamily='monospace', bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
